source.author: verg
source.text: Qualis apud gelidi cum flumina concitus Hebri sanguineus Mavors clipeo increpat atque furentis bella movens immittit equos; illi aequore aperto ante Notos Zephyrumque volant; gemit ultima pulsu Thraca pedum; circumque atrae Formidinis ora Iraeque Insidiaeque, dei comitatus, aguntur:
source.text_original: Qualis apud gelidi cum flumina concitus Hebri / sanguineus Mavors clipeo increpat atque furentis / bella movens immittit equos; illi aequore aperto / ante Notos Zephyrumque volant; gemit ultima pulsu / Thraca pedum; circumque atrae Formidinis ora / Iraeque Insidiaeque, dei comitatus, aguntur: /
source.text_english: As when, by the cold streams of Hebrus, blood-stained Mavors, aroused, clashes on his shield and, stirring up battles in frenzy, drives forth his horses; they fly over the open plain before the Notos and Zephyr; the farthest Thrace groans beneath the stamping of their hooves; and around them are driven the dark faces of Terror and Rage and Treachery, the divine escort of a god:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: mitte metus, volat ille mari quantumque propinquat, iam magis atque magis variis stupet Aea deorum prodigiis quatiuntque truces oracula Colchos.
reuse.text_original: 'mitte metus, volat ille mari quantumque propinquat, / iam magis atque magis variis stupet Aea deorum / prodigiis quatiuntque truces oracula Colchos.
reuse.text_english: Dismiss your fears; he is flying over the sea, and the nearer he draws, the more and more Aea is amazed at the various portents of the gods, and the fierce oracles shake the Colchians.
